scenarios.when: the active host cannot be identified as Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, or Trae
scenarios.then: ask the user which supported host they use and do not modify files

scenarios.when: no local terminal, PowerShell, exec, or shell execution is available
scenarios.then: state that automatic local upgrade cannot run and provide the next official copyable command for the identified host; do not claim success

scenarios.when: the freshly cloned official main branch fails npm run check or is no longer clean after validation
scenarios.then: report the validation failure and stop before changing installed Skills. Do not run generators, docs sync, formatters, repair commands, Git writes, or any other source-mutating command to make the cloned source pass.

scenarios.when: a current or retired target directory is missing the matching managed Skill markers
scenarios.then: report the exact conflict and stop before changing any target directory; do not overwrite, delete, rename, or merge it

scenarios.when: a verified retired managed Skill directory is present in the target root
scenarios.then: move it to a recoverable hidden backup in that target root before installing current Skills; do not delete it

scenarios.when: a supported host has no conflicting target directories
scenarios.then: run the official sync command once, report every installed or upgraded Skill, and tell the user to start a new host conversation
